name: XLD
description: Comprehensive testing of autonomous systems through simulation is essential to ensure the safety of autonomous driving vehicles. This requires the generation of safety-critical scenarios that extend beyond the limitations of real-world data collection, as many of these scenarios are rare or rarely encountered on public roads. However, evaluating most existing novel view synthesis (NVS) methods relies on sporadic sampling of image frames from the training data, comparing the rendered images with ground-truth images. Unfortunately, this evaluation protocol falls short of meeting the actual requirements in closed-loop simulations. Specifically, the true application demands the capability to render novel views that extend beyond the original trajectory (such as cross-lane views), which are challenging to capture in the real world. evaluation_method: image reconstruction quality metrics for novel view synthesis (e.g., PSNR, SSIM, LPIPS)
reputation: A recent synthetic dataset benchmark for autonomous-driving novel view synthesis, with emerging use in the vision and driving-simulation community.
notes: Non-LLM vision benchmark; designed for closed-loop and cross-lane novel-view evaluation, so standard in-distribution NVS metrics may not fully capture real utility.
